# Zoominfo

ZoomInfo is a go-to-market intelligence platform that provides AI-powered B2B data and sales intelligence to help GTM teams find in-market buyers, build pipeline, and close deals faster.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zoominfo/.

## Actions

- **News Search** (read-only): Returns a list of news articles from zoominfo's data which meet the specified search criteria.
- **Company Enrich** (read-only): Company enrich
- **Company Search** (read-only): Returns a list of companies from zoominfo's data which meet the specified search criteria.
- **Company Search Inputs** (read-only): Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the company search action.
- **Contact Enrich** (read-only): Contact enrich
- **Contact Search** (read-only): Returns a list of contacts from zoominfo's data that meet the specified search criteria.
- **Contact Search Inputs** (read-only): Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the contact search action.
- **Intent Enrich** (read-only): Intent enrich
- **Intent Search** (read-only): Use this endpoint to search for companies and recommended contacts based on intent data.
- **Intent Search Inputs** (read-only): Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the intent action.
- **Location Enrich** (read-only): Location enrich
- **News Enrich** (read-only): News enrich
- **News Search Inputs** (read-only): Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the news search endpoint.
- **Scoop Enrich** (read-only): Scoop enrich
- **Scoop Search** (read-only): Returns a list of scoops from zoominfo's data which meet the specified search criteria.
- **Scoop Search Inputs** (read-only): Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the scoop search action.
- **Technology Enrich** (read-only): Technology enrich
